claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The paper operationalizes the SPACE framework through extensive repository mining to show limitations of deterministic, unidimensional productivity heuristics.
claims.quote: This empirical investigation elucidates the limitations of deterministic, unidimensional productivity heuristics by operationalizing the SPACE framework through extensive repository mining.

claims.claim: It uses open-source repository data with Generalized Linear Mixed Models and RoBERTa-based sentiment classification to build a holistic, multi-faceted productivity metric.
